title: Plans and perspectives
theme: A video, a film and a song to explore at your own pace.

items.title: Easy Arabic — Basic Phrases: What will you do at the weekend?
items.creator: Easy Languages
items.difficultyReason: Provisional: natural language outside Ismi; listening review is pending.
items.description: A short conversation about weekend plans.
items.prompt: Notice how a plan is introduced. Compare the situation with Ismi’s planning dialogue without assuming the dialect is identical.
items.textAlternative: Read the downloaded What are we doing tomorrow? dialogue. Identify the plan and the response, then imagine a different day without changing the taught model.
